headline: Executive order on screening foreign nationals who may pose terrorism, national security, or public safety threats to the United States.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with keeping foreign terrorists and other people seen as national security or public safety threats out of the United States. It likely covers how the government screens and vets people from other countries who want to come to or stay in the U.S. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, steps, and deadlines are not described here.
